reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multilingual Support and Enhanced Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to announce some significant improvements in Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible to players worldwide. Additionally, we've introduced clearer placement feedback, so you'll know exactly why a placement might fail. No more guessing! Plus, our day/night transitions are now smoother, ensuring your colony runs seamlessly regardless of the time of day. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: New Language Support and Improved Gameplay Feedback
steam.body: We're excited to share that Provincia now supports ten languages in the build UI, enhancing accessibility for all players. Additionally, we've refined our placement feedback system to ensure you know exactly why a placement fails, reducing frustration. Plus, our day/night transitions have been optimized for smoother gameplay. Read more about these updates and how they improve your experience: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
